text: Color scan copy of passport (photo page) Photographs taken within the past six months (no headwear, frontal vertical format, one-inch ID photo, JPG or JPEG format, not larger than 1MB) Original color scan of the highest academic degree certificate (or notarized Chinese/English copy) Economic guarantee certificate Deposit certificate (bank transaction record within the past 6 months, with the balance in the card being no less than the tuition fee to be paid) Those under the age of 18 must provide a letter of authorization. No criminal record Physical examination report (within the last 6 months)
